title: Delta Ledger Baseline Establishment — Board F
type: Read-Only Baseline Establishment — No Content Modifications
authority: S350 Delta Review Scorecard (Board F); S204 Delta Review Results (Board D); S202.1 Artifact Storage Spec
purpose: Validate deterministic hashing, classification logic, and baseline integrity. Establish reference ledger. Do not claim savings yet.

delta_ledger_stateless_status.description: The delta ledger requires a historical baseline (a prior scan artifact) to compare against the current scan artifact. Without at least two scan artifacts across different sessions, no delta comparison can be computed.
delta_ledger_stateless_status.current_state: FIRST_BASELINE — S322 certification_scan_artifact.json is the first and only production artifact. No prior artifact exists for comparison. All 2,540 items would receive deltaClassification: UNCLASSIFIED (first scan, no baseline exists).
delta_ledger_stateless_status.minimum_requirement: At least one subsequent session must produce a scan artifact (e.g., S206) before the delta ledger can compute ANY comparison.
delta_ledger_stateless_status.expected_first_comparison: S830 Phase 2 Gate — when a second scan artifact exists from a post-Hybrid session.
delta_ledger_stateless_status.status_at_s351: INSUFFICIENT_DATA — delta ledger has no operational history. This is expected at P0.

IR-001_NO_CHANGE.description: Item content hash identical to prior scan. Inherit Certified status (CertifiedDelta). Zero review.
IR-001_NO_CHANGE.validation_status: SPECIFIED — cannot be tested without comparison data

IR-002_EW_ONLY.description: Only ExplanationWrong fields changed. Partial review — audit new EW text only. Inherit structural verdicts.

IR-003_METADATA_CHANGED.description: Only non-content metadata changed (difficulty, cognitive level, tags). Skip content review. Verify metadata.

IR-004_CONTENT_CHANGED.description: Stem, Choices, or CorrectChoice changed. Full re-review required.

IR-005_STRUCTURE_ONLY.description: JSON structure changed (field order, formatting) but content identical. Skip review.

inheritance_rules_validation.validation_verdict: SPECIFICATION_VALID — all 5 rules are logically sound and have unambiguous detection criteria. Operational validation requires at least one comparison cycle.

deterministic_hashing.description: SHA-256 of canonical content fields (Stem, CorrectChoice, Choices, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrongA-D). Excludes metadata fields (QuestionID, question_state, difficulty, etc.).
deterministic_hashing.verification_status: INFRASTRUCTURE_VERIFIED — hash_engine.js is operational and self-tested in S322. Determinism not yet validated across independent runs because no comparison data exists.
deterministic_hashing.determinism_test: NOT_YET_EXECUTED — requires two independent AM-1 runs on the same pack file, computing content hashes, and comparing results. Target: 100% identical across runs.

delta_classifications: UNCLASSIFIED — No baseline exists. First scan for this item.
NEW_ITEM — Item did not exist in prior scan.
UNCHANGED — Content hash identical to prior scan baseline.
CONTENT_CHANGED — Content hash differs due to stem/choices/CC/EC change.
METADATA_CHANGED — Content hash unchanged but non-content fields changed.
EW_ONLY — Content hash differs solely due to ExplanationWrong field changes.
STRUCTURE_ONLY — Content semantically identical, structure differs.
classification_logic.detection_mechanism: Per-item SHA-256 comparison between current artifact perItemResults.contentHash and prior artifact perItemResults.contentHash for same compound key.
classification_logic.classification_validity: UNVERIFIED — no comparison data. Logic is specified in IR-001 through IR-005 and is unambiguous, but operational validation deferred.

current_baseline_snapshot.pack_file_hashes: Recorded in S322 artifact. Packs A/C/D/E have drifted since (post-S726 development).

integrity_measures: Artifact SHALL NOT be overwritten mid-session — immutable once produced
Delta ledger entries keyed by compound key — survives QID renames
Prior artifact preserved in scripts/output/historical/ — audit trail retained
Content hash includes only content-fields — immune to metadata reorganizations
baseline_integrity.verdict: BASELINE_CAPTURED — S322 artifact serves as the T0 delta baseline. Integrity validations pass for the single-artifact state. Full integrity testing requires multi-session comparison chain.

TH-007_re_review_ratio.current: 100% (no delta review — all items need full review)
TH-007_re_review_ratio.note: 100% re-review until at least one comparison cycle completes

TH-008_skip_rate.current: 0% (no items can be skipped — first baseline)
